name: Mountain Pass point of no return
trigger: Entering Rosymorn Monastery Trail (or the Shadow-Cursed Lands)
consequence: Rescue the Gnome, Rescue the Grand Duke, Rescue the Trapped Man, Save the Goblin Sazza, Save the Refugees, and Rescue the Druid Halsin all fail silently.

name: Raid the Grove one-rest clock
trigger: Telling Minthara the grove's location (or Sazza + Minthara talk)
consequence: The raid triggers immediately after the next long rest; goblin leaders can despawn from their rooms.

name: Waukeen's Rest fire survivors
deadline: No long rest or fast travel before the rescues
consequence: Grand Duke Ravengard's men (Counsellor Florrick side) and trapped Benryn die in the fire.

name: Missing shipment (Zhentarim) gnoll clock
trigger: Approaching the cave on the Risen Road
consequence: Rugan and Olly are killed by the gnolls; Zhentarim reward line closes.

name: Mirkon at the harpy beach
trigger: Approaching the beach near the grove

name: Thulla's poison (Ebonlake Grotto)
trigger: Meeting poisoned Thulla in the Myconid Colony
consequence: Thulla becomes a myconid husk permanently.

name: Free True Soul Nere
trigger: Interacting with the cave-in rubble in Grymforge
consequence: Nere and the trapped deep gnomes die behind the rubble.

name: Auntie Ethel leaves the grove
trigger: Entering the Sunlit Wetlands (or robbing her stand)
deadline: Buy her potions before heading to the wetlands
consequence: Her grove shop (cheap healing potions) is gone for the run.

name: Andrick & Brynna hunt the owlbear
trigger: Telling the hunters to finish the owlbear
consequence: The owlbear (and cub recruitment chance) can be lost.

name: Withers in the Dank Crypt
trigger: Entering the goblin camp courtyard before opening his sarcophagus
consequence: Withers can disappear from the tomb — losing respecs and hireling revives for the run.

name: True Soul Edowin's siblings
deadline: Resolve before camping or fast travel

name: Dark Urge: bard visitor at camp
trigger: Crossing toward Blighted Village (Dark Urge origin only)
consequence: A forced camp scene kills Alfira (or Quill). Knowing it's coming avoids honor-run panic decisions.

name: Lae'zel's cage
trigger: Tieflings holding Lae'zel near the crash site
deadline: Early — the cage resolves on its own after enough time
consequence: She must be re-recruited later at the Mountain Pass.

name: Save Arabella (snake in the grove)
deadline: Before Defeat the Goblins / Raid the Grove completes
consequence: Arabella dies; her Act 2 storyline is lost.
